findings: Broad-index and all-A breadth alternatives did not improve the sealed 2018-2025 baseline.
SW L1 medium-term price scoring reduced turnover but lost the selection return.
retain_top20_hold10 passed the 20bp gates but failed because drawdown feedback made the 30bp path non-robust.
Market-wide stock money flow contains medium-term information, but the sealed exposure candidates failed the development and cost gates.
formal_changes: Avoid per-day namedtuple type creation during portfolio replay.
Use standard-library scalar math in risk calculations to reduce Windows native runtime pressure.
next_research_constraint: Use the registered market-flow information only in a predeclared walk-forward risk model or lower-friction execution design; do not tune thresholds on 2024-2026.
